import pandas as pd

FROM sensitive_area
WHERE category = 'RESIDENTIAL_AREA'
ORDER BY area DESC
LIMIT 1
""")

print(residential_df)

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Find the residential area with the largest area - get name and area
query = text("""
SELECT id, name, area, ST_Centroid(geometry) as centroid
FROM sensitive_area
WHERE category = 'RESIDENTIAL_AREA'
ORDER BY area DESC
LIMIT 1
""")
residential_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(residential_df[['id', 'name', 'area']])

# Store the residential area name
residential_area_name_largest = residential_df['name'].values[0]
print(f"Largest residential area: {residential_area_name_largest}, Area: {residential_df['area'].values[0]} sq meters")

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Get the centroid coordinates of the largest residential area
query = text("""
SELECT id, name, area, ST_X(ST_Centroid(geometry)) as lon, ST_Y(ST_Centroid(geometry)) as lat
FROM sensitive_area
WHERE category = 'RESIDENTIAL_AREA'
ORDER BY area DESC
LIMIT 1
""")
residential_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(residential_df)

res_lon = residential_df['lon'].values[0]
res_lat = residential_df['lat'].values[0]
print(f"Centroid coordinates: lat={res_lat}, lon={res_lon}")

# Find the nearest air quality monitoring station
query = text(f"""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_Distance(
    coordinate::geography,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint({res_lon}, {res_lat}), 4326)::geography
) as distance
FROM air_quality_station
ORDER BY distance
LIMIT 1
""")
nearest_station_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(nearest_station_df)

station_id_nearest = nearest_station_df['id'].values[0]
station_name_nearest = nearest_station_df['name_en'].values[0]
print(f"Nearest station: {station_name_nearest}, id={station_id_nearest}, distance={nearest_station_df['distance'].values[0]} meters")
